ge.wd1: English Expat Comedy Night, a free community choir and a crochet vernissage on Thursday, with GIFF still running.
ge.we1: Les Automnales opens at Palexpo, GIFF's final weekend, the year's last Terra 17 brocante, Plainpalais flea market and Paint & Prosecco on Friday; rain likely Friday.
ge.wd2: English stand-up on Tuesday and Wednesday, the English play The Lion and the Jewel in Coppet and a free choir on Thursday; rain likely most days.
ge.we2: Final weekend of Les Automnales, a brocante at the Maison des Associations, the English Philosophy Café and a drawing session at Atelier Pictura; rain likely Friday.

zh.wd1: English stand-up at Comedy Brew and the Funny Women Zurich showcase on Thursday, with Expovina on the lake ships.
zh.we1: The Uetliberg Christmas market opens, Basel's Herbstmesse ends, plus painting and watercolour workshops and English comedy; rain likely Friday.
zh.wd2: Lise Davidsen at the Opera on Tuesday, Sketch Circle on Wednesday, Comedy Brew on Thursday and the last days of Expovina; rain likely most days.
zh.we2: Art Meetup Zurich with 31 artists, the Räbechilbi lantern parade in Richterswil, Sketch Circle on Sunday and the Uetliberg market; rain likely Friday.

picks.why: Paint with a glass of prosecco and live music, indoors on a rainy night; easy to come alone and chat.
Opening weekend of Geneva's big autumn fair: food festival, wine fair and a shopping market under one roof.
Last Terra 17 brocante of the year: well-chosen vintage finds in a friendly indoor setting.
Bring a sketchbook and draw with a friendly group over drinks in Morges; free and relaxed.
Free English stand-up in the old town, with pros testing new jokes next to first-timers.
English stand-up with cocktails and Mexican food at El Catrín, featuring comedian-opera singer Steph Deprez.
The Geneva English Drama Society stages Wole Soyinka's classic Nigerian comedy, in English, in Coppet.
Free, friendly community choir in English; no experience needed, just turn up and sing.
Beginner-friendly painting workshop: a bold pop-art cat you take home, indoors on a rainy Friday.
Cosy watercolour session with tea in Winterthur; a calm way to paint and meet people.
The first Christmas market of the season opens on top of the Uetliberg; dog-friendly walk plus mulled wine.
Final weekend of Basel's 555th autumn fair: rides, food stalls and the historic Petersplatz market.
Star Norwegian soprano Lise Davidsen gives a song recital at the Zurich Opera House.
Drop-in sketching evening at the Coin Coin café-art space; all levels welcome.
Zurich's weekly English open mic, CHF 5: about ten comics a night and an easy crowd to join solo.
Last days of Expovina: taste wines from around the world aboard ships moored at Bürkliplatz.

a-ge-community-choir-free-11-05.desc: A free community choir at Holy Trinity Church: no experience needed, just enthusiasm. Songs from every continent and genre.

a-ge-vernissage-gito-ts-le-crochet-autre.desc: Opening of an exhibition of handmade crochet pieces by Jorge Trujillo (GITO TS) at La Nativa. A relaxed evening for craft lovers.

a-ge-brocante-mensuelle-au-coeur-de-gene.desc: The last monthly brocante of the year at Espace Terra 17: a curated mix of vintage furniture, tableware, books and curios in a warm indoor setting.

a-ge-pop-up-store-2026-11-07.desc: About twenty local designers and makers sell their work at Galerie Trajets' pop-up shop, open from 5 November to 3 December.

a-ge-paint-prosecco-live-music-11-06.desc: A relaxed painting evening with prosecco and live music, run by Social Circle; all materials provided and no experience needed. Tickets via the Social Circle link.

a-zh-drawing-workshop-realistisch-zeichn.desc: A realistic-drawing workshop for beginners, covering shading, proportion and perspective step by step; taught in English and German.

a-zh-paint-the-cat-11-06.desc: Beginner-friendly painting workshop where everyone paints a bright pop-art cat to take home; materials included.

a-ge-social-dinner-11-06.desc: Dinner at a table for six with new people, organised by Social Circle at La Santeria; book a seat via their site.

a-ge-drink-and-draw-11-07.desc: A friendly drawing meetup on the first and third Saturday of each month at the Black Horse in Morges: bring a sketchbook and draw together over a drink.

a-ge-marche-aux-puces-brocante-de-plainp.desc: Geneva's big open-air flea market on the Plaine de Plainpalais, every Wednesday and Saturday: antiques, vinyl, clothes and bric-a-brac.

a-ge-atelier-pictura-espace-du-quartier-.desc: Live-model drawing and painting session (18:30–20:30) at the Saint-Jean community space; all levels welcome, join via the group's WhatsApp.

a-ge-123-atelier-croquez-monsieur-madame.desc: Afternoon life-drawing session with two models (14:00–17:30) at the Saint-Jean community space; bring your own materials.

a-ge-portrait-club-geneva-11-08.desc: A Sunday portrait-drawing meetup in Geneva: take turns sitting and sketching each other; all levels welcome.

a-ge-tuesday-but-funny-english-comedy-11.desc: A free English stand-up night in the old town where professional comedians test new material alongside newcomers.

a-ge-the-lion-and-the-jewel-par-wole-soy.desc: The Geneva English Drama Society performs Wole Soyinka's classic Nigerian comedy, mixing storytelling, song and dance, in English.

a-zh-the-watercolour-circle-11-07.desc: A cosy watercolour session with tea at Zum Hinteren Hecht in Winterthur: slow down, paint and meet others; all levels welcome.

a-zh-zu-rich-mosaiklampen-herstellungs-w.desc: Make your own Turkish-style mosaic glass lamp in a hands-on workshop at the Art Masterclass Shop; all materials included.

a-zh-sketch-circle-zu-rich-coin-coin-11-.desc: A drop-in sketching evening at Coin Coin, a café, wine bar and art space by Ernst-Nobs-Platz; bring a sketchbook, all levels welcome.

a-zh-tea-ceremony-with-felix-11-07.desc: A calm afternoon tea ceremony with Felix at Bombay Birds, hosted by Social Circle; a gentle way to meet people. Tickets via Social Circle.

a-zh-digital-detox-cafe-11-08.desc: Phones away for an evening of conversation, games and painting at Paint it Easy, hosted by Social Circle; tickets via their site.

a-zh-liederabend-lise-davidsen-11-10.desc: Norwegian soprano Lise Davidsen, one of opera's biggest voices, gives a song recital on the Opera House main stage.

a-zh-werkschau-2026-der-ku-nstlervereini.desc: The Zurich Artists' Association shows new work by 24 artists across 180 m² at the Photobastei.

a-zh-art-meetup-zurich-11-14.desc: 31 artists bring their studios to Villa Bimbam for an afternoon: watch them work, chat and buy art directly.

a-zh-english-stand-up-comedy-show-11-06.desc: An English-language stand-up night at the new Tresor venue in Swiss Casino Pfäffikon.

a-zh-rachmaninow-die-drei-opern-11-08.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts all three of Rachmaninov's one-act operas in one evening at the Zurich Opera House.

a-zh-offenes-na-hatelier-11-05.desc: An open sewing studio: bring your own project and get help from an instructor with machines on hand.

add.title: GIFF — Geneva International Film Festival (32nd edition)
add.place: Théâtre Pitoëff and venues around town, Rue de Carouge 52, Geneva
add.desc: Ten days of films, series and immersive/VR experiences, with talks and big GIFF Night parties; many screenings are in English or subtitled.

add.title: Les Automnales — Geneva's autumn fair
add.desc: Geneva's big ten-day autumn fair: a food festival with bars and food trucks, the Arvinis wine fair, a shopping market and an upcycling area; open late on Fri and Sat.

add.title: Expovina — wine ships on Lake Zurich
add.desc: A Zurich classic: ships moored at Bürkliplatz become a floating wine fair with thousands of wines to taste; a fun after-work outing with friends.

add.title: Basler Herbstmesse — 555th Basel autumn fair
add.place: Barfüsserplatz, Münsterplatz, Petersplatz and more, Basel
add.desc: Switzerland's oldest and biggest funfair spreads over seven squares in Basel, with rides, mulled wine, roasted chestnuts and a crafts village and market at Petersplatz.

add.title: Räbechilbi Richterswil — turnip lantern parade
add.desc: Thousands of carved turnip lanterns light up Richterswil's old village in Europe's biggest turnip lantern parade, with a market and music from 15:00. A festival badge (CHF 10, cash) is required; no dogs or strollers.

add.title: Blickfang Zürich — design fair
add.desc: Independent design fair at the Kongresshaus: furniture, jewellery, fashion and homeware sold directly by the designers who make them.

add.when: Thu 19 Nov – Thu 24 Dec · daily from 11:00/12:00
add.title: Noël au Quai — Geneva's lakeside Christmas market
add.desc: Geneva's big Christmas market on the lakefront: wooden chalets, street food, a fondue chalet, a Christmas pub and a carousel. Opens 19 Nov from 17:00.

add.title: Montreux Noël — Christmas market on the lake
add.desc: One of Switzerland's best-known Christmas markets, with over 150 chalets along the lakefront, a flying Santa and extra stalls up at Château de Chillon and Rochers-de-Naye.

add.when: Weekends from Sat 7 Nov · Sat 12:00–20:00, Sun 10:00–18:00
add.title: Uetliberger Weihnachtsmarkt — Christmas market on Zurich's mountain
add.desc: Weekend-only Christmas market at the top of the Uetliberg, with craft stalls, mulled wine and views over the city; easy to combine with a short walk.

add.title: Polarzauber — Christmas market in Zürich HB
add.desc: One of Europe's biggest indoor Christmas markets fills the main station hall around a giant decorated tree, with gift stalls, food and bars.

add.title: Bellevue Noël — Christmas village on Sechseläutenplatz
add.desc: The new name for the old Wienachtsdorf: a Christmas village in front of the Opera House with craft chalets, food, a fondue chalet and a bar open late.

add.title: Weihnachtsmarkt Münsterhof
add.desc: A smaller, pretty Christmas market on the square by the Fraumünster church, with gifts, crafts and mulled wine.

add.when: Thu 19 Nov – Wed 23 Dec · weekdays from 16:00, weekends from 13:00
add.title: Singing Christmas Tree & market, Werdmühleplatz
add.desc: Choirs sing from a giant tree-shaped stage several times a day, surrounded by a small market and a fondue chalet.

add.title: Weihnachtsmarkt Dörfli in the Niederdorf
add.desc: Christmas stalls along the cobbled old-town lanes of the Niederdorf, good for small gifts and a stroll.

add.title: Zürcher Weihnachtsallee at Europaallee
add.desc: A Christmas avenue next to the main station with chalets, a Glühstube and a fondue chalet; opens 19 Nov at 16:00.

add.title: Nico Santos — live at Hallenstadion
add.desc: Pop singer-songwriter Nico Santos ("Rooftop", "Better") plays Zurich's big arena.
